=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:~line 425-429 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: ISSUE_BODY_FILE is read from os.environ in the baseline-branch step without being explicitly declared in that step's env block.
  WHY: The step depends on implicit GITHUB_ENV propagation from the prior step, which works but makes the dependency easy to shadow later.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:433-439 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Path.read_text() in the fallback handler can raise UnicodeDecodeError, which is not caught by except OSError.
  WHY: A non-UTF-8 cached ISSUE_BODY_FILE would crash the step before it can emit the fallback notice, although the case is unlikely and the workflow still fails open.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:436-439 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The fallback notice is emitted with print() instead of the existing notice() helper.
  WHY: This is only a consistency/hardening concern because the printed ::notice:: command still works as a GitHub Actions workflow notice.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:~line 453-475 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The metadata-footer regex captures everything to the end of the issue body, so any trailing signature or comment after the footer causes baseline resolution to fail.
  WHY: Because the parsed block includes all post-footer text, the trusted resolver rejects it and the workflow falls back to the integration/default branch.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:~line 497-508 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The metadata-line parser only accepts non-blank lines that start with "- ", so any formatting variation in the footer is treated as metadata-missing.
  WHY: A future producer that emits a differently formatted key line will cause trusted baseline resolution to fail closed and fall back.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:~line 698 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The checkout_ref step still writes dead outputs such as source=integration/default and ref=....
  WHY: No downstream step reads checkout_ref.outputs.source or checkout_ref.outputs.ref, so the writes are vestigial and only add maintenance noise.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
